svg.title: Version retention
svg.desc: Diagram of one document slot with six versions, v1 oldest and v6 latest. With versions_kept 3 and versions_retain_days 90, v4 to v6 are inside the count, v3 is outside the count but newer than 90 days, and only v1 and v2 are outside both limits, so only they are pruned.
